+def _is_empty_import_value(value: Any) -> bool:
+    if value is None:
+        return True
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return not value.strip() or value.strip() == '????'
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return not value or all(_is_empty_import_value(item) for item in value)
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        if 'name' in value:
+            return _is_empty_import_value(value.get('name'))
+        return not value
+    return False
+
+
+def is_incomplete_import_record(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the required metadata trio has a missing value."""
+    return any(
+        _is_empty_import_value(rec.get(field))
+        for field in ('title', 'authors', 'publish_date')
+    )
+
+
+def get_import_augmentation_identifier(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
+    """Prefer an ISBN-10, then use a non-ISBN Amazon ASIN."""
+    isbn_10 = rec.get('isbn_10')
+    if isinstance(isbn_10, str):
+        isbn_10 = [isbn_10]
+    if isbn_10 and (
+        identifier := next(
+            (i for i in isbn_10 if isinstance(i, str) and i.strip()), None
+        )
+    ):
+        return identifier
+    amazon_ids = (rec.get('identifiers') or {}).get('amazon') or []
+    if isinstance(amazon_ids, str):
+        amazon_ids = [amazon_ids]
+    if asin := next(
+        (
+            identifier
+            for identifier in amazon_ids
+            if isinstance(identifier, str) and identifier.upper().startswith('B')
+        ),
+        None,
+    ):
+        return asin
+
+    source_records = rec.get('source_records') or []
+    if isinstance(source_records, str):
+        source_records = [source_records]
+    return next(
+        (
+            record.split(':', 1)[1]
+            for record in source_records
+            if isinstance(record, str)
+            and record.lower().startswith('amazon:b')
+            and ':' in record
+        ),
+        None,
+    )
+
+
+def supplement_rec_with_import_item_metadata(
+    rec: dict[str, Any], identifier: str
+) -> None:
+    """Fill empty metadata fields from a staged or pending ImportItem, in place."""
+    from openlibrary.core.imports import ImportItem  # Avoid a circular import.
+
+    fields = (
+        'authors',
+        'publish_date',
+        'publishers',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'physical_format',
+        'isbn_10',
+        'isbn_13',
+        'title',
+    )
+    try:
+        item = ImportItem.find_staged_or_pending([identifier]).first()
+        if not item:
+            return
+        raw_metadata = item.get('data')
+        metadata = (
+            json.loads(raw_metadata or '{}')
+            if isinstance(raw_metadata, (str, bytes))
+            else raw_metadata or {}
+        )
+        for field in fields:
+            if _is_empty_import_value(rec.get(field)) and not _is_empty_import_value(
+                metadata.get(field)
+            ):
+                rec[field] = metadata[field]
+    except Exception:
+        logger.exception(
+            'Unable to supplement import record using staged item %s', identifier
+        )
+
